title: Fanin two implies well formedness
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean directed acyclic circuits, with one circuit for each input length. If every circuit in the family is well formed and every gate in each circuit has at most two arguments, then every circuit in the family is well formed.
hypotheses_covered: For every input length, every gate has distinct argument vertices and every NOT gate has exactly one argument
For every input length, every gate has at most two arguments
